module: Manages livery saves (dynamic decals editor) in settings/dynamicDecals/*.dynDecals.json. Allows listing, creating, renaming, deleting, saving and reloading a layer stack, and stores the name of the current save of the editing session. Relies on the editor_api_dynamicDecals extension for the actual serialization.
notes: File names must match ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ (letters, digits, _ and -); otherwise save/create/load/rename return false with a warning in the log.
Files are stored in settings/dynamicDecals/ with the extension .dynDecals.json.
exists and delete do not call name validation: they directly test the built path.
create and save return the file path (string) on success, and false on failure; load, rename and delete return a boolean.

exists.desc: Returns whether a save with this name exists in settings/dynamicDecals/.

getAll.desc: Lists all existing saves. Each entry contains name, location (path), created, modified and fileSize.

returns.desc: Array of entries {name, location, created, modified, fileSize}.

create.desc: Writes the current layer stack to a new file via editor_api_dynamicDecals.saveLayerStackToFile. Does not check whether the file already exists and does not change the current save.

returns.desc: Path of the written file, or false if the name is invalid.

rename.desc: Renames a save. Fails if the new name is invalid, the old file does not exist, the new name is already taken or the rename fails. Updates the current save name if it was this file.

delete.desc: Deletes the save file. If it was the current save, resets the session state via clearCurrentSave (the staged skin is no longer applied).

returns.desc: true if the file existed and was deleted.

getFilename.desc: Extracts the save name (without folder or .dynDecals.json extension) from a file path.

file.desc: Full path of a save file.

getCurrentSaveName.desc: Returns the name of the last save loaded or saved in this editing session.

returns.desc: nil for a new unsaved livery.

clearCurrentSave.desc: Forgets the current save and the staged skin (stagedApplySkinName).

consumeStagedApplySkin.desc: Returns the name of the skin staged by a save with applySkin and clears it (single read, intended for when the editor exits).

returns.desc: Name of the skin to apply, or nil.

save.desc: Saves the livery: refuses a name that is invalid or already taken by a save other than the current one, requires a player vehicle, writes the layer stack then exports the skin (exportSkin) under the same name. Then sets the current save and, if applySkin is true, stages the skin for when the editor exits.

applySkin.desc: If true, the exported skin will be applied when the editor exits (see consumeStagedApplySkin).

returns.desc: Path of the written file, or false on failure (invalid name, duplicate, no vehicle).

load.desc: Loads a save into the editor via editor_api_dynamicDecals.loadLayerStackFromFile (called under pcall). Sets the current save and clears the staged skin.
